NISAR velocity requirement validation

Each requirement is evaluated against GPS three ways (speed, vx, vy) using mosaic3d -obsDump rows at the GPS pixels, with the GPS forward-modelled through the solver's own weights and windows. Status is green when the RMS residual over stations is within the 1-σ tolerance now, amber when the fitted error curve reaches it at 30 cycles, red otherwise, grey when the data cannot test it.
